title: A team effort, on and off the field
alt: Cardinal Dynamics families, students, and supporters cheering in the stands
summary: Our mentors, families, and local supporters make room for students to learn, build, and compete. Thank you for being part of Cardinal Dynamics.
paragraphs: Cardinal Dynamics relies on the support of mentors, families, businesses, and community members. That support helps cover robot parts, registration fees, travel, and tools.
Thank you to Apple, Argosy Foundation, Microchip Technology, OnlineMetals.com, Troutdale Bikes, OSH Cut, Bandits Bar and Grill, and M & M Sourdough.
You can help through a donation, sponsorship, materials, tools, or mentoring. Contact the team to talk about how you would like to contribute.
